messages:
alice (sec-eng): Just finished applying patch for dependency libsession 2.3.1 -> 2.3.2 to address CVE-2026-4421. Starting post-patch validation checklist now.
ben (infra): canary rollout started to namespace=payments, deployment=libsession-canary, 5% traffic. deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for libsession-canary (rev 2026.03.15-7). /cc @carla
carla (sre): running quick smoke against payments API endpoints. small script: ```for u in /v1/auth /v1/session; do curl -sS -w "HTTP:%{http_code} T:%{time_total}\n" https://payments.redwood.ai${u}; done```
alice (sec-eng): also verify audit logs show new KMS key usage for envelope decryption — key alias "rwdw-prod-enc-v2" rotated as part of the patch. Run: `aws kms list-keys --profile prod | grep rwdw-prod-enc` then `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=rwdw-prod-enc-v2`
ben (infra): RBAC change applied: created role `patch-runner-deployer` with minimal perms and bound to service account infra/patch-runner. Policy snippet: ```- Effect: Allow\n  Action: [sts:AssumeRole, iam:PassRole, kms:Decrypt]\n  Resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/patch-runner-deployer```
carla (sre): smoke results: /v1/auth 200 T:0.18, /v1/session 200 T:0.21. No 5xx. CPU on canary pods ~22% of baseline, memory stable.
sre-oncall: watching error budget and 99p latency dashboard (datadog link: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/abc123/libsession-canary). Setting temporary alert: latency > 350ms for 5m triggers page.
alice (sec-eng): audit log check shows KMS Decrypt events at 2026-03-15T17:04Z from patch-runner SA, and CloudTrail entries include requestParameters.ciphertextBlob (expected). Good.
ben (infra): perf regression quick-run: `hey -n 1000 -c 20 https://payments.redwood.ai/v1/session` -> P50 95ms P95 210ms P99 330ms. Baseline before patch: P95 190ms. Small bump on tail, within canary thresholds.
carla (sre): added canary fallback policy: if error rate > 0.5% OR P99 > 400ms for 10m then rollback to libsession@2.3.1. deploy-bot: Canary policy attached.
mike (product): any visible impact for end users? customer-facing traces look normal. no complaints in support queue.
alice (sec-eng): cross-checked dependency tree for libsession — no additional transitive vulnerabilities. Logged follow-up ticket #ENGSEC-891 for longer soak and fuzz tests.
sre-oncall: enabling extra log-level sampling for canary pods for next 2 hours: `kubectl annotate deployment libsession-canary datadog-log-sample=true`
carla (sre): written quick healthcheck to run every 30s for the canary: ```- name: libsession-canary-health
  run: curl -fsS https://payments.redwood.ai/health || exit 1```
alice (sec-eng): KMS rotation verification note: rotated key version 3 is being used by canary. Confirmed HSM logs show successful decrypt ops. Leaving canary running for 2 hours then widen to 25% if no regressions. :thumbsup:
ben (infra): will push RBAC and terraform diff to infra repo. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/pulls/314 (please review)
carla (sre): will monitor alerts and escalate if breach of thresholds. If all good by +2h, we promote to staged and run full e2e perf suite.
alice (sec-eng): thanks team. tagging incident bot: small-note: postpatch-validation OK so far, will update ENGSEC-891 after soak.
deploy-bot: Canary completed 2h soak, promoted to 25% traffic.
carla (sre): final note: no new errors, latency within SLOs, audit/KMS checks clean. closing thread, will add summary to the patch ticket.
